title: Doobee Configuration
description: Configuration for the Doobee automated issue resolver

$schema.description: Path or URL to the JSON Schema for editor validation

baseBranch.description: Base branch to create feature branches from

commands.description: Lifecycle commands run at various stages of a solve session

setup.description: Run once before processing issues (e.g. ["npm ci"])

start.description: Run before each session (e.g. ["docker compose up -d"])

stop.description: Run after each session (e.g. ["docker compose down"])

verify.description: Verify the build (e.g. ["turbo typecheck lint build"])

maxRetries.description: Maximum retry attempts before marking an issue as stuck

promptContext.description: Additional context injected into the Claude prompt (e.g. repo structure, conventions)

model.description: Claude model to use (e.g. claude-sonnet-4-5-20250929, claude-opus-4-6)

timeout.description: Maximum time in seconds for a Claude invocation before it is killed

ports.description: Env var names that need unique free ports (e.g. ["DB_PORT", "ADMIN_PORT"])
